phases.title: Governance, source register and completeness controls
phases.user_value: Makes every later claim bounded, auditable and lawful.
ingestion_update: No new corpus text; register and access tests
documentation: Whole-Law scope, evidence rules, source onboarding runbook
risks: False confidence if governance is treated as paperwork
phases.rollback: Whole-Law root remains draft; existing legislation pack unchanged.

phases.title: Harden and federate the existing legislation baseline
phases.user_value: Preserves proven discovery while making temporal and coverage limits explicit.
dependencies: legislation.gov.uk fair use and public API
phases.rollback: Use prior descriptor/release and disable Whole-Law extension entrypoints.

phases.title: Case-law discovery and court coverage federation
phases.user_value: Users can locate official judgments across UK jurisdictions without implying completeness.
documentation: Case-law source hierarchy and licence boundary
evaluation: Cross-jurisdiction case retrieval and absence tests
acceptance: England/Wales, Scotland and NI all represented
Every court row exposes coverage status
No case holding generated from metadata only
phases.rollback: Disable affected source adapter; retain source register/live links.

phases.title: Licensed case text, citation graph and reviewed treatment pilot
phases.user_value: Passage-supported interpretation and a defensible first public citator layer.
ingestion_update: Licensed text snapshot or approved live processing
evaluation: Treatment precision/recall sample and hard-failure tests
acceptance: Treatment edge has source and target passages
Expert precision threshold >=0.98 on pilot sample
phases.rollback: Remove text/treatment pack; retain public metadata and citation occurrences only.

phases.title: Procedure, forms, fees and court-service information
phases.user_value: Actionable procedural research with currentness safeguards.
evaluation: Deadline, forum, form and fee journeys across jurisdictions
acceptance: Every action-critical answer links operative rule and live service artefact
phases.rollback: Disable cached currentness and show live links only.

phases.title: Regulatory rules, guidance and enforcement
phases.user_value: Separates binding rules, guidance and outcomes across regulated sectors.
acceptance: No regulator document lacks force type
Formal decision is primary display for outcomes
FCA failure state remains visible until resolved

phases.title: Treaties, EU and ECHR federation
phases.user_value: Tracks external legal sources and UK obligations without conflating international and domestic effect.
evaluation: Treaty in-force/domestic effect and EU-version tasks
acceptance: International status and domestic effect shown separately
No translation treated as authentic without source flag
phases.rollback: Keep UK metadata and external live links only.

phases.title: Legislative history, law reform and inquiries
phases.user_value: Reconstructs development, intent, scrutiny and recommendations.
evaluation: Wrong Bill version, selective quote and implementation tests
acceptance: Every historical document has non-operative role
phases.rollback: Discovery metadata with no automated intent synthesis.

phases.title: Public guidance, ombudsmen, legal aid and distributed local law
phases.user_value: Supports public and operational users while preserving authority boundaries.
evaluation: Accessible explanations, vulnerable-user and no-record attacks
acceptance: Local byelaw coverage remains unknown unless denominated
phases.rollback: Live links and source register only.

phases.title: Scale, advanced semantics and sustainable service operation
phases.user_value: Reliable national-scale service rather than a one-off research artefact.
evaluation: Load, resilience, drift, security, accessibility and expert audit
acceptance: Hard-failure rate zero in release gate sample
phases.rollback: Freeze latest signed snapshot and disable live/synthesis claims.
